name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 18 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 18 hours starting 2026-06-08, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.78 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
